overview: You dated the page the twenty-fourth of March 1594 and wrote that the reading is not a beginning. No man has a line. You have not said a name aloud to hear it. The cloth goes back. Brooke stays.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the stop and left Brooke where it was.
